import Testing
@testable import Lib

@Suite("Named suite")
struct NamedSuite {
    @Test("表示名つき 成功") func passes() { #expect(one() == 1) }
    @Test("表示名つき 失敗") func failsNamed() { #expect(one() == 2) }
    @Test func failsUnnamed() { #expect(one() == 3) }
    @Test("parameterized 失敗", arguments: [1, 2, 3]) func param(x: Int) { #expect(x != 2) }
}

@Suite struct OtherSuite {
    @Test func otherPasses() { #expect(true) }
}
